lines.en: Is the tea ready?

lines.text: Erê. Min çaya pêşî vexwar; ev ya duyem e.
lines.en: Yes. I drank the first tea; this is the second.

lines.text: Payîz çawa bû?
lines.en: How was the autumn?

lines.text: Payîzeke hêja bû. Her kesî karê xwe kir, û bername û planên me pêk hatin.
lines.en: It was a worthwhile autumn. Everyone did their work, and our programme and plans came true.

lines.text: Me armanca xwe bi dest xist: berhemeke baş!
lines.en: We reached our goal: a good harvest!

lines.text: Û armanca min?
lines.en: And my goal?

lines.text: Armanca te? Fêrbûn, gav bi gav. Û tu ji niha ve gelek dûr hatiyî.
lines.en: Your goal? Learning, step by step. And you’ve already come a long way.

lines.text: Û Xezal?
lines.en: And Xezal?

lines.text: Ew ê biçe, lê rehên wê li vir in, û dilgermiya gund jî.
lines.en: She will go, but her roots are here, and the warmth of the village too.

lines.text: Çîrokbêj dest pê dike. Niha guhdarî bikin… Hebû tunebû…
lines.en: The storyteller begins. Now listen… Once upon a time…
